description.fun: Mime Jr. loves imitating others, though it isn't very good at it yet. It copies a foe's moves to confuse it, then slips away, but it sometimes gets so pleased with itself that it forgets to keep the act going. It likes busy places like markets, and in Galar it idolises the tap-dancing Mr. Rime and practises its steps.
description.guide: A small, pink Psychic and Fairy baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 4 that loves to imitate others. It evolves into Mr. Mime when levelled up knowing Mimic, or into Galarian Mr. Mime if it evolves in Galar. It was pure Psychic before Generation 6.
description.tagline: A little mime still learning the act

description.fun: Mr. Mime is a born pantomime artist, and it's not just pretending: by vibrating its fingertips, it solidifies air into real invisible walls. It doesn't take kindly to anyone who interrupts its act or isn't impressed, and slaps them. It's such a good mime that it's hard to tell whether it's asleep or just pretending to be. Before Generation 3, its name had no space: Mr.Mime.
description.guide: A humanoid Psychic and Fairy Pokémon that is a skilled mime, able to make invisible walls by solidifying the air with its fingertips. It evolves from Mime Jr. and was pure Psychic before Generation 6. Its Galarian form is an Ice and Psychic type that evolves into Mr. Rime.
description.tagline: A mime whose invisible walls are actually there

names.ja: ガラル バリヤード

description.fun: Galar's Mr. Mime is a tap dancer rather than a mime, dressed like it's wrapped up for winter. It controls temperature through its feet to make a floor of ice to dance on, which it can kick up as a barrier.

names.th: กาลาร์ บาลิโคโอรุ

description.fun: Mr. Rime tap-dances with an ice cane and a comical routine that's so popular Galar's Mime Jr. copy its steps. The act is a trap, though: the moment an opponent laughs, it blasts them with air at −200°C. Its face hardly moves, but the 'face' pattern on its belly changes to show its feelings. Its bowler-hat look recalls the Tramp of silent films.
description.guide: An Ice and Psychic Pokémon introduced in Generation 8, the evolution of Galarian Mr. Mime. It tap-dances with a cane made of ice and releases psychic power through the pattern on its belly. Its look is based on a mime, a tap dancer and a silent-film comedian.
description.tagline: A tap-dancing comedian with a freezing punchline

note.text: Mime Jr. is a baby Pokémon, added in Generation 4, three generations after the Mr. Mime it grows into.

transitions.how: Level up, knowing Mimic, in Galar

note.text: Same Mimic, different place: any Mime Jr. that evolves in Galar becomes Galarian Mr. Mime, wherever it came from.
Only Galarian Mr. Mime evolves further, into Mr. Rime; Mr. Mime from other regions doesn't evolve.
